arcs.name: The Last Wall
arcs.purpose: Establish Stonehold, the Lantern Guard and the ordinary cost of the Veil.

arcs.name: Ashes of the Past
arcs.purpose: Turn the missing patrol into evidence of a deeper wound.

arcs.name: The Bell Below
arcs.purpose: Introduce Eir-Vhal and establish the Veil-stitching mystery.

arcs.name: A Door That Remembers
arcs.purpose: Show that the threat remembers people and uses old institutions.

arcs.name: The Wastes Remember
arcs.purpose: Reveal that corruption is moving along ancient roads and teaching living creatures to carry the old seal.

arcs.name: The Eastern Road
arcs.purpose: Follow the old road network and discover that dead authority still issues commands.

arcs.name: The Crown Beneath
arcs.purpose: Recover the first stitching record from the buried royal court.

arcs.name: Roads That Remember
arcs.purpose: Prove that the roads are memory channels reopening beneath the world.

arcs.name: The Hollow Court
arcs.purpose: Discover that an ancient court survives inside the Veil as memory.

arcs.name: The First Stitch
arcs.purpose: Trace the first stitch and learn what was sacrificed to create it.

arcs.name: The Bells Beneath the World
arcs.purpose: Bring the campaign to its first conclusion: the bell can be silenced, but memory must be chosen.

regionIdentity.identity: Fortified human capital; politics, duty, markets and class trainers.
Ancient forest guarding a buried wound; lantern trails, roots and Veil scars.
Blackened badlands where old roads and living corruption overlap.
Fortress-city built around a sealed door; military memory and the old court.

regionIdentity.name: Eastern Reach
regionIdentity.identity: Wind-cut frontier farms and caravan roads between Stonehold and the northern ash routes.
regionIdentity.gameplay: Road patrols, beast packs, contested ore veins, a roaming elite guardian and caravan-focused quests.

regionIdentity.name: Old Kingdom
regionIdentity.identity: Ruined royal heartland where broken keeps and forgotten roads expose the history beneath Ashenfall.
regionIdentity.gameplay: Undead patrols, relic ruins, higher-tier ore, a rare guardian and exploration quests.

regionIdentity.name: Briarfen
regionIdentity.identity: Drowned thorn marshes where old Lantern Guard causeways disappear beneath black water.
regionIdentity.gameplay: Marsh patrols, lantern restoration, thorn creatures, caravan routes and a Fen Reclamation event.

regionIdentity.name: Sunscar Steppe
regionIdentity.identity: Red-grass caravan frontier where old battlefields overlap living trade roads.
regionIdentity.gameplay: Caravan defense, raider camps, battlefield hunts and the Sunscar Caravan War.

regionIdentity.name: Crownfall Expanse
regionIdentity.identity: Broken royal heartland where the dead court still enforces its ancient roads.
regionIdentity.gameplay: Royal undead patrols, ruined estates, memory seals and the Crownfall Rebellion.

regionIdentity.name: Veilscar Highlands
regionIdentity.identity: Storm-battered black highlands above the oldest Veil scar.
regionIdentity.gameplay: Aether storms, highland patrols, dangerous climbs and the Highland Storm event.

regionIdentity.name: Nightveil Coast
regionIdentity.identity: Storm-dark coast where drowned armies protect a road toward the Hollow.
regionIdentity.gameplay: Drowned warbands, black tides, exposed ruins and the Nightveil Black Tide event.

questCategories.main_story: Primary arc progression and world revelations.
questCategories.character: NPC lives, local people, survivors and faction consequences.
questCategories.exploration: Discovers roads, landmarks, hidden places and rare creatures.
questCategories.dungeon: Introduces dungeon lore and contextualizes its encounters.
questCategories.class: Class identity, combat philosophy and personal mastery.
questCategories.regional_story: Zone-specific campaign quests that bridge the main story through the expanded world.

creditRules.kill: Party-share when quest is accepted, same zone, within 120m, online/alive and level-eligible.
creditRules.dungeon: Party-share for active participants in the same dungeon run.
creditRules.dungeon_stage: Party-share for active participants in the same dungeon run.
creditRules.travel: Individual; discovering a place belongs to the character.
creditRules.talk: Individual; the character must personally speak to the NPC.
creditRules.mine: Individual; gathering ownership stays with the miner.
creditRules.craft: Individual; crafting mastery belongs to the crafter.

worldPhases.description: Stonehold openly records the sixth lantern incident.
Lantern Guard patrols receive additional authority.
The Covenant is treated as a source of intelligence rather than an immediate enemy.
Hollow manifestations may be approached without immediate hostility in narrative events.
The final memory choice becomes the campaign ending state.
